info.title: Event Notifications Polling
info.description:
An API to retrieve event notifications in batches and mark them complete after processing. 

Each tenant can have multiple feeds. By default there is an 'all' feed (i.e. /v1/all/next) that will contain all notifications and a feed per event source (i.e. /v1/entitydata/next). 

It is expected there will be a single logical consumer per feed. If fan-out handling is desired, this shouldbe done on the consumer side. As is the case with messaging based systems, this is at-least once delivery with best effort ordering.

post.description: This method will mark a batch of notifications as completed.

parameters.name: feedId
parameters.description: The feed identifier. Each tenant has by default 'all' feed which contains all notifications and feed per specifc event source (i.e. document, entitydata, journey, screening)

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: The batch identifier. Id of batch of event notifications which will be processed and set to complete after processing.

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

id.description:
The notification identifier. If a duplicate event notification occurs, it will have the
same identifier as the previous instance.

eventType.description: An event notification type in the format of "source:event". e.g. "entitydate:created".

tenantId.description: The tenant identifer associated with the notification.

causationId.description: Id that caused the notification, typically the ID of the resource/event

correlationId.description: A correlation identifier if there is one

relativeUrl.description: A URL to get the resource the notification is related to.

moreAvailable.description:
Indicates whether there are more batches on the server. Clients can check this to decide to perform
an immediate requests or pause until the next polling interval.
